Newest to oldest Sort April 2, 2025 This app was added by our retail team primarily to facilitate inventory counts. While it works well for a one-time year-end count, we found there to be gaps when conducting counts over time, using a perpetual inventory count system. At minimum, the CSV downloads of inventory counts should list the date the count was conducted and the stocktake number so that the downloads can be traced back to an individual count in Stocky. Preferably, users should be able to download multiple counts into one CSV, with dates and stocktake numbers listed. The app would also benefit from a report that could tell you the date an item was last counted. Show more Ten Thousand Villages Abbotsford Canada 29 days using the app Shopify replied April 28, 2025 Hi there! Thank you so much for sharing your feedback! Those are great suggestions, and I can definitely see why having the date/number of the stocktake on the CSV download would be helpful. Although you can edit the name of the CSV file to include that information on your device, I understand that this may not help if you are then printing out that file as a physical copy for review. Our development team are constantly trying to improve the app functionality, so I will absolutely relay all your suggestions to them and thanks for bringing it to our attention! If you have any further feedback you'd like to share, please do feel free to reach out via https://shopify.link/vRnL and we can take a look for you. Thanks so much! - Natasha, Shopify Support Show more Edited November 5, 2024 Why does every update lower the functionality of the app?? - You now have to click edit on every PO to make updates (change it back!) - The new colour scheme does not let you easily differentiate between orders pending and received (change it back!) - When importing goods, sometimes you do not know the total landed costs until after all the import duties and taxes are paid. Stocky LOCKS the landed costs once goods are received. We need to be able to update shipping costs post order - to accurately see the Landed Costs (Please fix this as it is the most crucial part) -------------------------------------------------------------------- Reply 05/11/2024 In reply to the comment "you can click the Edit button on the top of a received purchase order to open up the option to adjust the shipping rates as needed." - the figures such as the margin and landed costs remain locked if you have already received the items, so this is not an acceptable solution. Please can you contact me directly to discuss improvements. Show more Cyril R. Salter United Kingdom Almost 5 years using the app Shopify replied November 5, 2024 Hello Cyril, thank you for taking the time to submit this feedback. Our developers work to ensure that we are providing the best service possible and all feedback is valuable to us, so I would be more than happy to pass the concerns you have noted along to them on your behalf. I can confirm that the option to edit shipping costs after an order is received would be possible at the moment, you can click the Edit button on the top of a received purchase order to open up the option to adjust the shipping rates as needed. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to our Shopify Help Center at help.shopify.com and our 24/7 support team would be happy to assist. Show more May 14, 2024 Used to be better, but could do with some updates as a lot of features aren't working anymore. I use Stocky to see what products are selling well, what will be depleted soon and what products need reordering. Show more Slam69 United Kingdom Over 4 years using the app Shopify replied May 15, 2024 Thanks for the review. I would suggest attempting to clear the cache on your browser to see if that fixes the issue that you are experiencing with some of Stocky's features: https://shopify.link/b7xY. If you continue to experience these issues, you can get in touch with our live support to have a further look by navigating to our Help Center: https://shopify.link/goV1. -Ollie, Shopify Support Show more Edited September 30, 2024 Some needed functionality: 1. Receiving vouchers, so an invoice can have multiple receipts against it. 2. When receiving, the dollar total should only include what is checked off as received. 3. Ability to print barcode labels for specific items on a PO, or invoice, etc. 4. Ability to sort documents while viewing. Right now you have to go into settings if you want to sort differently. 5. (September 2024) Update no longer allows you to edit product costs while receiving. Show more Head Shoulders Toes & Bows United States About 5 years using the app February 6, 2025 app won't open - keep getting an error code!! Show more Elements Berkeley United States Over 1 year using the app Shopify replied February 17, 2025 Thank you for your review! It's unfortunate that you're receiving an error code when trying to open the app. I suggest contacting the Support team through our Help Center at https://help.shopify.com/ to get some help troubleshooting that issue and to restore your access. We're available 24/7! - Erin, Shopify Support Show more April 5, 2017 worth having and worth the money for sure. it's just a little hard to undertand how all the featurs works. Show more Ecigaretteempire United States 10 days using the app January 15, 2020 Can someone tell me what is going on? I can not access my Stocky App via shopify. This is the error message i am getting. ..........."Shopify plan upgrade required Stocky is only available for specific Shopify plans. To download Stocky for free, upgrade your plan to Shopify or Advanced Shopify. ".......... Is it no longer supported? I am still being billed Show more Crank & Stroker Supply Co. United States 3 months using the app Shopify replied January 17, 2020 Hi there, thank you for taking the time to review Stocky - we appreciate your feedback. I have taken a look at this and it seems that Stocky is now working on your account if you would like to retry accessing it. Stocky is no longer available on the Basic plan unless it was installed prior to October 31st 2019 and the store & app are in continuous use from that time - the app is included in all plans above the Basic plan for free. I have more details specific to what happened in this case which I will share with you via email. Thank you - Beckha Show more August 5, 2020 Is there a Stocky App for the smartphone or Iphone and the barcode functionality to do Stockcount seems very limited. The pricelist for each product with different suppliers would be very good followed by the currency symbol which is currently missing. Show more Beautywholesale United Kingdom 2 days using the app Edited October 30, 2020 POSHBABY.COM - This App is SO CLOSE to being really really good. I'm still in the initial "testing phase" but seeing some easy but valuable things that I wish it had or I can't find and hope they do :). How/can you have open purchase order items show up on the inventory items page in Shopify as INCOMING? It seems if an item is on order, it should show as INCOMING. This is critical to have for staff to be aware of what we have coming and not have to go and search every open PO from a vendor. A way to remove the “default” text from a purchase order that has no variant. Can you print the PO and not have to download it first? Easy access to a number of useful metrics. Subjectively, it's somewhat pricey and never seems to really improve much. Pros: Lots of data, interface is easy to understand. Starts working quickly. Cons: Interface is very space inefficient (columns with single letters taking up ~150 px), errors and weirdness in the data, bugs go reported and never fixed (like it's crazy to me that the filter for active items only still shows unlisted items months after i emailed them about it). Also, not only is the interface wasteful on screen real estate, but its actively gotten worse as they discontinued the old tool that was better for a new one... support said they would address that tab columns couldnt be shrunk down more like the old tool-- but then never did. Some metrics also just fail to work-- cool: you can show me 40 different metrics! uncool: 10 dont actually work. Also constantly pushing annoying AI in your face which is, on its best day, half as useful as just using Chatgbt. Also, how it calculates the prediction is both a black box, has limited customizations and sometimes is crazy flawed. I actually built a more useful/customized tool just with spreadsheets and Chatgbt for effectively $0 extra dollars. I've emailed you. We'd like to understand what went wrong, what you were trying to achieve and see if we can get your workflow going properly. A couple of clarifications for others reading: 1. Using ChatGPT for inventory management - We already have a MCP that brands can use with either ChatGPT or Claude. It's well documented in our help centre. 2. How our prediction works - There is a well documented article called Deep Dive into How Smart Model Forecasts Are Generated in our help center. 3. Our AI agent, PIA, is a free choice to use. Other brands have shared a lot of positive feedback about because it is trained only on inventory specific workflows. Get more information about it on our website. 4. Regarding the feedback on UI, we are constantly working to improve our app based on feedback from multiple brands. The changes to UI have to be prioritised. Please read rest of our App store reviews and also our review summary, brands say that our UI is the best in the ecosystem.
